course.header.title: Explore Courses
course.header.subtitle: Learn sign language at your own pace with our comprehensive courses
course.available.title: Bisindo (Bahasa Isyarat Indonesia)
course.available.description: Master the Indonesian sign language alphabet. Learn to fingerspell your name and spell out words letter by letter. Perfect for beginners starting their sign language journey.
course.coming_soon.notify: Be notified when this course launches
course.asl.title: American Sign Language (ASL)
course.asl.description: Learn the most widely used sign language in North America. Master ASL alphabet, common phrases, and conversational skills used by millions of deaf and hard-of-hearing individuals.
course.bsl.title: British Sign Language (BSL)
course.bsl.description: Discover the official sign language of the United Kingdom. BSL has its own grammar and is used by over 150,000 people. Learn the fundamentals of this rich visual language.
course.lsf.title: French Sign Language (LSF)
course.lsf.description: Explore Langue des Signes Française, the sign language used in France and French-speaking regions. LSF influenced many other sign languages including ASL.
course.csl.title: Chinese Sign Language (CSL)
course.csl.description: Learn the sign language used by millions in China. CSL combines visual signs with unique grammatical structures distinct from spoken Chinese languages.
